entityTypes.name: cell
entityTypes.description: One recorded low-threshold spiking interneuron. The dataset holds one cell, Experiment-9862.

cell_id.name: cell_id
cell_id.title: Cell identity
cell_id.description: Name of the cell's folder, as the data descriptor's <identity>.

dataLocations.description: Carannante et al., electrophysiological recordings of a striatal low-threshold spiking interneuron (dataset version 495de3d5-f9d5-4a4a-acd2-4ade0eaefb22, bucket pc0a33-hbp-d000007_LTS-ephys_pub). The data descriptor's layout is 2019Q3/<cell type>/<analysis|derived|original>/<identity>; this location is the derived branch of 2019Q3, with one root per cell-type folder (lts), and holds the derived traces per cell, ASCII text. Every entry below the roots was listed.

filePatterns.name: traces
filePatterns.description: One trace per channel and sweep, <condition>_<protocol>_ch<N>_<sweep>. Even channels hold the current in pA, odd channels the voltage in mV; time in ms.
